description: The National Institute of Statistics and Censuses of Costa Rica documents in its microdata archive the 2024 construction statistics, built from the building permits that municipalities approve and send to INEC. The catalogue entry read on 2026-09-28, last modified on 16 December 2025, describes records of private new construction, extensions, repairs, earthworks and demolitions in 2024, excluding public works, with variables for province, canton, permit type, class and destination of the work, economic activity, housing, area, value in colones, and the predominant floor, wall and roof materials. Coverage is national, down to canton. Access is not a free download: the access policy lists agreements with public or academic institutions, direct purchase at a cost, or a request to the INEC information centre; INEC owns the rights and must be cited. Caveats: permits record construction intentions that INEC does not verify in the field. It supports building stock and exposure modelling, such as updating counts and materials of new dwellings by canton. Related record: the CFIA construction statistics give the engineers association view of the same permits.
